note: Concept data. Prices are illustrative estimates incl. 22 % VAT, ex works Straža, not an official Solis Timber price list.

sl.name: Skobljan les
sl.short: Gladke, ravne deske in letve, pripravljene za delo.
sl.use: Notranje pohištvo, police, vrtno pohištvo, obloge, otroški izdelki (zaobljeni robovi).

en.name: Planed timber
en.short: Smooth, square boards and battens, ready to use.
en.use: Indoor furniture, shelves, garden furniture, cladding, kids' items (rounded edges).

sl.name: Radialen les
sl.short: Radialno žagan, brez stržena: deske ostanejo ravne.
sl.use: Mizne plošče, vrata, okvirji, klopi za savno, obloge, panjski okvirji.

en.name: Quarter-sawn timber
en.short: Radially sawn, no pith: boards stay flat.
en.use: Tabletops, doors, frames, sauna benches, cladding, beehive frames.

sl.name: Suh žagan les
sl.short: Tehnično sušen, površina naravnost z žage.
sl.use: Konstrukcije, vrtne gradnje, rustikalen videz, les, ki ga boste skobljali sami.

en.name: Dry sawn timber
en.short: Kiln dried, surface straight from the saw.
en.use: Frames, garden builds, rustic looks, stock you will plane yourself.

sl.name: Svež žagan les
sl.short: Najcenejši, a moker: se bo krčil in zvijal.
sl.use: Kompostniki, grobe vrtne gradnje, opaž, palete, les za lastno sušenje.

en.name: Fresh sawn timber
en.short: The cheapest, but wet: it will shrink and move.
en.use: Compost bins, rough garden builds, formwork, pallets, stock to air-dry yourself.

sl.name: Lepljen nosilec BSH GL24h
sl.short: Raven, stabilen, nosilen, do 13,5 m. Odrezan na mero.
sl.use: Stebri in tramovi za pergole, nadstreške, preklade; pod streho.

en.name: Glulam BSH GL24h
en.short: Straight, stable, strong, up to 13.5 m. Cut to length.
en.use: Posts and beams for pergolas, carports, lintels; under a roof.

sl.name: Konstrukcijski les KVH
sl.short: Novo: vzdolžno spojen C24, skobljan. V pripravi.
sl.use: Ogrodja lop, špirovci, stebri, vidni tramovi v notranjosti.

en.name: Structural timber KVH
en.short: New: finger-jointed C24, planed. Coming soon.
en.use: Shed frames, rafters, studs, visible indoor beams.

extras.sl: Suha žagovina za steljo, vreča 50 l
extras.en: Dry sawdust for bedding, 50 l bag

pickup.en: Pickup at the sawmill in Straža

van.en: Van (up to 4 m, up to 1 t)
